title: Per-repo routing overlay
description: A consumer's routing overlay, committed as .github/ops-routing.json in the repo the events fire from. Merged over the framework base table (route-map.schema.json) at the edge: identity is the pair (event, label), an overlay rule with the same key WINS, and an overlay rule with loop:null DISABLES the base rule with that key. Keys present in only one source are taken as-is. Most repos need no overlay at all — the base table is the whole point. JSON rather than YAML because route-event.sh runs at the CI edge with bash + jq only and no yq; see docs/capabilities-migration-plan.md §6.4.

version.description: Matches the base table's version. A mismatch means the overlay was written against a different rule shape.

routes.description: Overlay rules. An empty array is legal and means 'the base table, unchanged'.

event.description: Must come from the framework event vocabulary. Inventing a string here is a conformance violation and route-event.sh rejects it loudly rather than never firing.

label.description: The label that fired. Use "" for an event carrying no label.

loop.description: The loop to dispatch to, overriding the base rule with this (event, label). NULL disables the base rule entirely, which is how a repo opts out of one of the framework loops without forking the base table.
